questions.question: Identify correct or incorrect from the following statements i. FORTRAN is a high-level programming language. ii. A debugger is used to find and fix errors in source code. iii. The output of a debugger is an executable file.
questions.questionHtml:
Identify correct or incorrect from the following statements

i. FORTRAN is a high-level programming language.

ii. A debugger is used to find and fix errors in source code.

iii. The output of a debugger is an executable file.

options.text: i - correct, ii - correct, iii - incorrect
options.html: i - correct, ii - correct, iii - incorrect

options.text: i - correct, ii - incorrect, iii - correct
options.html: i - correct, ii - incorrect, iii - correct

options.text: i - incorrect, ii - correct, iii - correct
options.html: i - incorrect, ii - correct, iii - correct

options.text: i - correct, ii - correct, iii - correct
options.html: i - correct, ii - correct, iii - correct

questions.solution:
The correct answer is i - correct, ii - correct, iii - incorrect

Key Points

  • i. FORTRAN is a high-level programming language.
    • Correct. FORTRAN (Formula Translation) is one of the earliest high-level programming languages.
  • ii. A debugger is used to find and fix errors in source code.
    • Correct. A debugger is a tool that helps developers find and fix errors (bugs) in their programs.
  • iii. The output of a debugger is an executable file.
    • Incorrect. The output of a debugger is not an executable file; it assists in debugging but does not produce executable files.

Correct Answer: 1) i - correct, ii - correct, iii - incorrect

questions.question: Bug in computer terminology means _________

options.text: a logical error in a programme
options.html: a logical error in a programme

options.text: documenting programmes using efficient documentation tool
options.html: documenting programmes using efficient documentation tool

questions.solution:
The correct answer is a logical error in a programme.

Key Points

  • A bug in computer terminology refers to an error, flaw, or fault in a computer program that causes it to produce an incorrect or unexpected result, or to behave in unintended ways.
  • This term was first used by Grace Hopper in 1947 when a real insect caused a malfunction in the Mark II computer.
  • A logical error in a program is an error in the algorithm or logic that produces unintended or incorrect results.
  • Debugging is the process of finding and fixing bugs in a computer program.

questions.solution: The Control Panel in Windows OS is a centralized location for managing settings, and installing software, and hardware. It includes applets like programs and features, device manager, display settings, and user accounts. questions.question: Which of the following control windows panel items in windows 10 lets users uninstall preinstalled programs on the computer?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following control windows panel items in windows 10 lets users uninstall preinstalled programs on the computer?
questions.solution: Programs in the Control Panel allows users to uninstall preinstalled programs on a Windows 10 computer. By navigating to "Programs and Features" within this section, users can view and remove installed applications.

questions.question: Which of the following is a Programming Software?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is a Programming Software?
questions.solution: Visual Basic is a programming software used to develop applications. Unlike utility software like Disk Cleanup and Disk Defragmenter, which manage system performance, Visual Basic provides tools and an environment for writing, testing, and debugging code.

questions.question: Identify correct or incorrect from the following statements i. C is a high-level programming language. ii. A compiler translates high-level code into assembly language. iii. The output of a compiler is typically an executable file.
questions.questionHtml:
Identify correct or incorrect from the following statements

i. C is a high-level programming language.

ii. A compiler translates high-level code into assembly language.

iii. The output of a compiler is typically an executable file.

options.text: i - correct, ii - correct, iii - incorrect
options.html: i - correct, ii - correct, iii - incorrect

options.text: i - correct, ii - incorrect, iii - correct
options.html: i - correct, ii - incorrect, iii - correct

options.text: i - incorrect, ii - correct, iii - correct
options.html: i - incorrect, ii - correct, iii - correct

options.text: i - correct, ii - correct, iii - correct
options.html: i - correct, ii - correct, iii - correct

questions.solution:
The correct answer is i - correct, ii - incorrect, iii - correct

Key Points

  • i. C is a high-level programming language.
    • Correct. C is considered a high-level programming language, although it is closer to low-level compared to other high-level languages like Python.
  • ii. A compiler translates high-level code into assembly language.
    • Incorrect. A compiler generally translates high-level code directly into machine code (binary code), not just assembly language.
  • iii. The output of a compiler is typically an executable file.
    • Correct. The primary output of a compiler is an executable file.

Correct Answer: 2) i - correct, ii - incorrect, iii - correct

questions.question: Identify correct or incorrect from the following statements i. Java uses both compilation and interpretation. ii. A linker combines multiple object files into a single executable file. iii. An interpreter produces object files as output.
questions.questionHtml:
Identify correct or incorrect from the following statements

i. Java uses both compilation and interpretation.

ii. A linker combines multiple object files into a single executable file.

iii. An interpreter produces object files as output.

options.text: i - correct, ii - correct, iii - incorrect
options.html: i - correct, ii - correct, iii - incorrect

options.text: i - incorrect, ii - correct, iii - correct
options.html: i - incorrect, ii - correct, iii - correct

options.text: i - correct, ii - incorrect, iii - correct
options.html: i - correct, ii - incorrect, iii - correct

options.text: i - correct, ii - correct, iii - correct
options.html: i - correct, ii - correct, iii - correct

questions.solution:
The correct answer is i - correct, ii - correct, iii - incorrect

Key Points

  • i. Java uses both compilation and interpretation.
    • Correct. Java code is first compiled into bytecode, which is then interpreted (or compiled) by the Java Virtual Machine (JVM).
  • ii. A linker combines multiple object files into a single executable file.
    • Correct. A linker takes one or more object files produced by a compiler and combines them into a single executable file.
  • iii. An interpreter produces object files as output.
    • Incorrect. An interpreter does not produce object files; it executes the code directly.

Correct Answer: 1) i - correct, ii - correct, iii - incorrect

questions.question: The process of starting a computer by initiating through hardware such as a button press, or by a software command is called ________.
questions.questionHtml: The process of starting a computer by initiating through hardware such as a button press, or by a software command is called ________.
questions.solution: Booting is the process of starting a computer by loading the operating system into RAM, initiated through hardware or software. It involves a startup sequence essential for computer operation. There are two types: Warm Booting (resuming from sleep mode) and Cold Booting (starting from a powered-off state).

questions.question: Which process includes fixing of security holes in the system?
questions.questionHtml: Which process includes fixing of security holes in the system?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Patching.

Key Points

  • Patching is the process of fixing security vulnerabilities and other bugs by applying updates or "patches" to the software or system.
  • It is a crucial part of maintaining the security and integrity of any IT system.
  • By regularly applying patches, organizations can protect themselves from potential exploits and attacks that take advantage of known vulnerabilities.

Additional Information

  • Risk Control: This involves identifying, assessing, and prioritizing risks followed by coordinated application of resources to minimize, control, and monitor the probability or impact of unfortunate events. It does not specifically involve fixing security holes.
  • Data Encryption: This is a method of converting data into a code to prevent unauthorized access. While important for data security, it does not fix security holes in the system.
  • Risk Likelihood: This refers to the probability of a risk occurring. It is a part of risk assessment but does not involve fixing security holes.
